verdicts.reason: A keeps a dominant headline and a prominent CTA, but it splits the list: the first bullet is enlarged and sits on its own, the grocer tagline is wedged into the middle of the list, and the remaining bullets are reversed and stepped down the page out of alignment. The logo is shrunk to a footer chip and the can floats in the lower-right beside a large dead zone. B has the same broken, reordered list, and its hierarchy is worse: the CTA is pushed into a small top-right corner pill, the legal line sits near the top, the headline is shrunk and wraps, and an oversized logo pill at the bottom becomes the strongest focal point.
